cookieBridgeMissing.message: Chrome could not find the native host registration

cookieBridgeForbidden.message: Chrome does not allow this extension to use the host

cookieBridgeApi.message: Native Messaging API is unavailable in this worker. After granting permission, reload the extension and retry.

cookiePrivacy.message: Cookies may grant access to your signed-in account. Only your chosen scope is synchronized. Values are never displayed or logged.

cookieRegistration.message: First register the native bridge in desktop Settings with this exact extension ID and browser:

cookieDomainHint.message: Access includes these domains and their subdomains over HTTPS. YouTube preset includes only youtube.com. No automatic Google/account scopes.

cookieConsent.message: The selected cookies will be read by this extension, sent only via Native Messaging, and encrypted with Windows DPAPI in local AppData. Revoke below or delete synced data in desktop Settings. Already running downloads may retain their temporary jar.

cookieConsentCheck.message: I consent to reading the domains shown above

cookieDeleteConfirm.message: Remove this profile from the list? If active, synchronization is disabled and data deletion in the app must be confirmed first. Browser cookies remain unchanged.

cookieDone.message: Operation acknowledged. Check profile status below.

cookieFailed.message: Sync/delete could not be acknowledged. Check the native bridge. If revocation is pending, also delete synced cookies in desktop Settings.

cookieInvalid.message: Check consent, exact domains, and interval. Current service requires one domain.

cookieMetadataOnly.message: Metadata only. Partitioned cookies are excluded. Select the cookies you consent to sending.

cookieRevokeConfirm.message: Disable this scope and delete its synced data? Existing downloads cannot be recalled.

cookieContinue.message: Session refresh failed. Continue using the last available snapshot, or without cookies if none exists?

extensionDescription.message: Send HTTP/HTTPS media URLs to ModernTubeDownloader; YouTube quick actions.

qualityHint.message: Quality means up to the selected resolution. The app selects the closest lower available quality.

playlistDescription.message: Add the entire playlist or analyze it in ModernTubeDownloader to review items.

mediaDescription.message: Add the media or analyze it in ModernTubeDownloader to choose the file format.

liveHint.message: The app checks the state: a completed replay goes to the download queue; active or scheduled LIVE requires separate confirmation. Recording never starts automatically.

unsupportedHint.message: Open an HTTP/HTTPS page or use the link context menu.

ready.message: Ready to hand off to the app

handoff.message: App launch requested. Confirm the browser prompt if shown. This does not confirm a queued download.

analyzing.message: The app will analyze the URL and show available options.

genericHint.message: The desktop app checks yt-dlp support, authentication and media type. Quick queue uses Best / Auto; playlists and LIVE require selection.

quickQueueAction.message: Quick queue (Best / Auto on other sites)

preferencesError.message: Preferences could not be saved. Reopen the extension popup.

platformNotice.message: Support is determined by desktop yt-dlp, not by the extension.

languageDescription.message: One language for the popup, settings, menus and YouTube buttons. Auto follows the browser, not the desktop app.

aboutTransport.message: The extension hands URLs to the installed app. It does not download media or require an account.

resetConfirmation.message: Reset ModernTubeDownloader language, quality, integration and action preferences? Other browser data stays unchanged.
